translations.web: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
translations.bsb: A bribe is a charm to its giver; wherever he turns, he succeeds.
translations.kjv: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
